in_marathi.name: Sacchidanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truthful, Pure, Blissful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sacchidanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sacchidanand is a name of God, meaning 'He who is the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss'. It is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'sacchid' (truth) and 'anand' (bliss). This name signifies the eternal, unchanging nature of the divine, and evokes feelings of peace, purity, and happiness.
